newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Vitoria airport cargo up 63 pct in Nov 96.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Vitoria airport cargo up 63 pct in Nov 96.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Vitoria airport in northern Spain rose by 63 percent in November to 3,999 tonnes from 2,447 tonnes in the same month last year, the airport authority said.
This takes the accumulated total this year to 23,764 tonnes against 11,556 tonnes in the first 11 months of last year.

Vitoria, which started commercial cargo operations in 1994, has been showing monthly growth rates of at least 60 percent this year and is becoming an important centre for frozen fish and mail. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
